soccer:547213.body: Chory has been removed from Slavia Prague's first-team squad until the end of the autumn part of the season, which rules him out of the Champions League matches against Villarreal and Bayern Munich and will be allowed to leave in the winter transfer window, the club announced in October.
soccer:547213.head: Out of squad for rest of autumn

soccer:547214.body: Sallai suffered a muscle strain in the back of his thigh during the warmup before Hungary's Nations League match against Northern Ireland and will undergo an MRI and further checks at Galatasaray, with his chances of playing against Samsunspor and Aston Villa very low, according to Haberler .
soccer:547214.head: Unlikely to face Aston Villa

soccer:547216.body: Cakir (shoulder) is unlikely to be ready for Galatasaray's league match against Samsunspor but is targeting a return for the Champions League match against Aston Villa, according to Hurriyet .
soccer:547216.head: Targets return against Aston Villa

soccer:547218.body: Lynen missed Wednesday's training session due to illness, leaving his availability for Sunday's game against Hamburger in doubt, Werder Bremen announced .
soccer:547218.head: Misses training through illness

soccer:547219.body: Pinckert (ankle) has yet to return to team training after picking up an injury against Borussia Dortmund, leaving his availability for Saturday's clash with Freiburg in serious doubt, according to Saarbrucker Zeitung .
soccer:547219.head: Yet to return to training

soccer:547220.body: Gyamerah (thigh) appears to have returned to full team training after missing recent games with muscular problems, potentially putting him in contention for Saturday's clash against Freiburg, according to Saarbrucker Zeitung .
soccer:547220.head: Returns to team training

soccer:547221.body: Darvich (hamstring) has returned to team training after overcoming his muscular problems and could be available for Saturday's clash against Freiburg, according to Saarbrucker Zeitung .
soccer:547221.head: Back in training ahead of Freiburg

soccer:547222.body: Zimmerschied (ankle) has returned to full team training after recovering from an ankle ligament injury, putting him in contention for Saturday's Bundesliga clash against Freiburg, according to Saarbrucker Zeitung .
soccer:547222.head: Resumes full team training

soccer:547223.body: Backhaus (thumb) returned to team training Wednesday after withdrawing early from Germany's U21 squad due to the injury, putting him in line to feature against Elversberg on Saturday.
soccer:547223.head: Resumes training after injury

soccer:547224.body: Frimpong (hamstring) was pictured on the pitch at Liverpool's training ground Wednesday as he continues his recovery.
soccer:547224.head: Steps up recovery on pitch

soccer:547225.body: Caicedo (undisclosed) will be checked over at Cobham on Thursday morning before training after he asked to come off at halftime of Ecuador's friendly against Bolivia, with coach Xabi Alonso expected to give an update at his press conference on Friday afternoon, according to Kieran Gill of Daily Mail .
soccer:547225.head: To be assessed Thursday

soccer:547227.body: Anunga has suffered a leg injury that will force him to miss the Wild Card match against Orlando City on Thursday, the MLS announced Wednesday.
soccer:547227.head: Out for Wild Card round

soccer:547228.body: Toklomati suffered an apparent leg injury and was substituted early in the second half of Israel's match against Austria on Tuesday, though general manager Zoran Krneta did not sound concerned that it is anything serious, per Carroll Walton of The Charlotte Ledger .
soccer:547228.head: Injury on Israel duty not serious

soccer:547229.body: Musovski (head) has been removed from the MLS Player Status Report ahead of the Wild Gard games, so he's likely to be available going forward.
soccer:547229.head: Not on injury report

soccer:547230.body: Davies (hamstring) could miss a few games as the club believes he's facing a 2-3 week recovery timeline, per Maximilian Koch of Abendzeitung .
soccer:547230.head: Expected out 2-3 weeks

soccer:547231.body: Sanchez was forced off in the 24th minute of Colombia's friendly against Chile on Tuesday after taking a hard blow that appeared to affect his shoulder, which could affect his availability for Galatasaray's Champions League game against Aston Villa, though he said after the match that the substitution was precautionary, per redgol . "I spoke with the doctor and wanted to test how I felt, but it was all precautionary. Fortunately, over the next few days I'll recover my strength and mobility. It's nothing I haven't been through before."
soccer:547231.head: Downplays injury after early exit

soccer:547232.body: Dubravka is dealing with a minor knee injury which forced him to sit out the Nov. 7 clash against Leeds and be excluded from Slovakia's squad over the international break, per Tashan Deniran-Alleyne of The Standard .
soccer:547232.head: Misses international duty with knee issue

soccer:547233.body: Osimhen (knee) has started training work but appears unlikely to start Tuesday's Champions League match against Aston Villa, with the Nov. 30 derby against Besiktas his main target, according to Yagiz Sabuncuoglu .
soccer:547233.head: Back in training after surgery

soccer:547235.body: Morante will miss at least the derby against Sevilla due to a pinched muscle in his hip, Pepe Cano of VamosmiSevillaFC.com reports.
soccer:547235.head: Sidelined with hip problem

soccer:547236.body: Aguado (ankle) said in an official Elche interview that his injury "is in the past now, and I'm giving it my all to return as soon as possible," and he's aiming to be available for the league match against Atletico Madrid on Nov. 28, Felipe Canals of Onda Cero reports.
soccer:547236.head: Nearing return to action

soccer:547237.body: Vertrouwd has been struggling with an issue that forced him to leave the pitch after coming off the bench in the last match against Real Sociedad, with coach Benat San Jose saying "He asked for the substitution... Having to leave the pitch after coming on is never what you want. But sometimes you have to listen to your body so as not to make things worse," according to Maite Martin of As .
soccer:547237.head: Recovering from physical discomfort

soccer:547238.body: Kumbulla is still working on his recovery from an undisclosed issue as manager Benat San Jose hopes to have him back after the international break "I am optimistic, and I believe that after the FIFA break they will be available," per Maite Martin of As .
soccer:547238.head: Hopeful to appear after break

soccer:547239.body: Medina was absent in Wednesday's practice due to injury, Felipe Galindo of Multimedios reports.
soccer:547239.head: Dealing with fitness concern

soccer:547242.body: Zubimendi (hamstring) is dealing with a muscular issue after being forced off in the 72nd minute of Spain's Nations League defeat to England on Sunday, according to Kostas Lianos of The Sun.
soccer:547242.head: Dealing with hamstring issue

soccer:547243.body: Heaven (undisclosed) withdrew from England U20's squad Sunday due to injury, missing Tuesday's 2-1 victory over Portugal, according to the club .
soccer:547243.head: Returns to Manchester with issue

soccer:547244.body: Onyeka (groin) is expected to return for Saturday's Premier League clash against Crystal Palace after missing Coventry City's previous encounter against Everton before the break, according to Brian Dick of the Coventry Telegraph.
soccer:547244.head: Expected back against Crystal Palace

soccer:547245.body: Thomas (calf) is working toward a return for Saturday's Premier League clash against Crystal Palace after missing Coventry City's previous encounter against Everton before the break, according to Brian Dick of the Coventry Telegraph.
soccer:547245.head: Working toward Crystal Palace return

soccer:547246.body: Mason-Clark is expected to miss two to three weeks after sustaining a minor knee injury during training ahead of Coventry City's clash against Everton before the break, according to coach Frank Lampard, per Brian Dick of the Coventry Telegraph. "He picked up a small injury in his knee yesterday in training, we are hoping he will be 2-3 weeks."
soccer:547246.head: Sidelined with knee issue

soccer:547247.body: Eccles (ankle) has resumed light work on the grass but remains outside Coventry City's team training sessions, with no confirmed timeline for his return, according to coach Frank Lampard, per Brian Dick of the Coventry Telegraph. "They're back on the grass, but very tentative at the minute. They're not with us, so I don't really have a timeline on them, but they're working very hard to be fit, and we hope to have them, I would say, in the next weeks with us training properly."
soccer:547247.head: Continues individual ankle recovery

soccer:547248.body: Woolfenden (knee) has resumed light outdoor training but is not yet participating in full team sessions, with his return date still uncertain, according to coach Frank Lampard, per Brian Dick of the Coventry Telegraph. "They're back on the grass, but very tentative at the minute. They're not with us, so I don't really have a timeline on them, but they're working very hard to be fit, and we hope to have them, I would say, in the next weeks with us training properly."
soccer:547248.head: Still working toward team return

soccer:547249.body: Dybala (calf) has logged back-to-back full practices and is set to be available against Parma on Saturday, Tuttomercatoweb reported.
soccer:547249.head: Poised to be back versus Parma

soccer:547250.body: Martinez (thigh) returned to full training Tuesday and will be an option versus Atalanta on Sunday, barring a setback, Corriere dello Sport reported.
soccer:547250.head: Fully on track for Atalanta clash

soccer:547251.body: Fadera (thigh) resumed working with the rest of the group Wednesday, Cagliari announced.
soccer:547251.head: Likely for Como fixture

soccer:547252.body: Cambiaghi (ankle) trained with no limitations Wednesday, Bologna relayed.
soccer:547252.head: Good to go for Udinese tilt

soccer:547253.body: Folorunsho (calf) has reprised training regularly during the break and is expected back for Monday's game versus Fiorentina, Gianluca Di Marzio reported.
soccer:547253.head: Probable for Fiorentina match

soccer:547254.body: van Dijk (undisclosed) is expected to be available for Sunday's Premier League clash against Manchester United despite withdrawing from the Netherlands squad due to a lingering fitness issue, according to Paul Wheelock of the Liverpool Echo.
soccer:547254.head: Expected fit for Man United clash

soccer:547255.body: Diaz (hamstring) will miss Friday's Bundesliga clash against Koln but could return for Wednesday's UCL encounter against Lille after making encouraging progress in his recovery, according to coach Vincent Kompany . "Lucho is doing very well. He's had a good week. It'll be too soon for tomorrow, but we should be able to get him back into action within the next seven days."
soccer:547255.head: Nearing return

soccer:547256.body: Ceballos (undisclosed) resumed team training Thursday after missing the previous two sessions due to physical discomfort and is likely to be available for Saturday's La Liga derby against Sevilla, according to Zona Mixta .
soccer:547256.head: Returns to team training

soccer:547257.body: Musiala (thigh) is available and likely to be included in Bayern Munich's squad for Friday's Bundesliga clash against Koln, according to coach Vincent Kompany, per iMiaSanMia . "He's ready, he's available and will probably be involved, yes. I say 'probably' because we still have a training session today, and something can always happen."
soccer:547257.head: Likely to feature against Koln

soccer:547258.body: Ndiaye (abdomen) has been training with Bayern Munich's senior squad in recent days after recovering from an appendectomy and could be available for Friday's Bundesliga clash against Koln, according to the club .
soccer:547258.head: Rejoins senior training

soccer:547260.body: Mendy (knee) is expected to be available for Sunday's Premier League clash against Brighton after recovering from the discomfort that forced him to withdraw from Senegal's national team camp, according to Barry Cooper of Hull Live.
soccer:547260.head: Likely for Brighton clash

soccer:547261.body: Belloumi (hamstring) has resumed training with Hull City this week and is expected to return for Sunday's Premier League clash against Brighton after missing the defeat to Arsenal and Algeria's international fixtures, according to Barry Cooper of Hull Live.
soccer:547261.head: Expected back against Brighton

soccer:547262.body: Ansah (back) has made encouraging progress in his recovery during the international break and remains on track to resume full team training within the next couple of weeks, according to Barry Cooper of Hull Live.
soccer:547262.head: Closing in on full training return

soccer:547263.body: Hughes (abdomen) played 60 minutes for Hull City's U21 side in Tuesday's 4-2 victory over Sheffield Wednesday, continuing his recovery from double hernia surgery, according to Barry Cooper of Hull Live.
soccer:547263.head: Builds fitness with another U21 outing

soccer:547265.body: Houary (ankle) remains absent from Elche's team training sessions and is likely to miss Monday's La Liga derby against Levante, according to Jorge Adsuar Jimenez of Pasion Franjiverde.
soccer:547265.head: Absent from training ahead of derby

soccer:547268.body: Danjuma (thigh) rejoined Valencia's team training session Thursday after missing Wednesday's activities due to discomfort in his right thigh and could be an option for Saturday's clash against Rayo Vallecano, according to Tribuna VCF .
soccer:547268.head: Returns to group training Thursday

soccer:547269.body: Otorbi (hamstring) participated in the opening stages of Valencia's team training session Thursday, marking another step in his recovery ahead of Saturday's La Liga clash against Rayo Vallecano, according to Tribuna VCF .
soccer:547269.head: Rejoins team training

soccer:547270.body: Frimpong (hamstring) participated in Liverpool's team training session Wednesday as he continues recovering from an injury sustained in October, the club posted .
soccer:547270.head: Resumes team training

soccer:547271.body: Le Guen (fibula) has resumed light jogging after suffering a fractured fibula in late September but remains several weeks away from returning to competitive action, according to Le Telegramme .
soccer:547271.head: Resumes jogging after fibula fracture

soccer:547272.body: Toure (groin) has been ruled out for Sunday's Ligue 1 derby against Rennes due to a right adductor injury sustained before the international break, according to Le Telegramme .
soccer:547272.head: Ruled out against Rennes

soccer:547274.body: Katseris (adductor) continues to train separately from his Lorient teammates and remains without a confirmed return date as he recovers from his latest injury setback, according to Ouest France .
soccer:547274.head: Still training separately, no return date

soccer:547276.body: Mata (undisclosed) has not been participating in Lyon's team training session Thursday ahead of Sunday's Ligue 1 clash against Lille, leaving his availability for the encounter uncertain, according to Olympique et Lyonnais .
soccer:547276.head: Absent from training

soccer:547277.body: Frankowski (muscular) returned from international duty with Poland carrying a new muscle injury and is doubtful for Sunday's Ligue 1 derby against Lorient, according to Le Telegramme .
soccer:547277.head: Returns from Poland with muscle injury

soccer:547278.body: Cubarsi (hip) resumed team training with Barcelona on Thursday after recovering from iliopsoas muscle tightness and is likely to be available for Sunday's La Liga clash against Villarreal, according to Alex Pintanel of Esports RAC1.
soccer:547278.head: Likely to return against Villarreal

soccer:547279.body: Bellanova (thigh) has been training fully in recent days and will return against Inter, Tuttomercatoweb reported.
soccer:547279.head: Set to be back versus Inter

soccer:547280.body: Raspadori (thigh) resumed working with the rest of his teammates during the break, L'Eco di Bergamo reported.
soccer:547280.head: Slated to return against Inter

soccer:547281.body: Silva (undisclosed) participated fully in Real Madrid's team training session Thursday after recovering from a minor physical issue and will be available for Saturday's La Liga clash against Celta Vigo, the club posted .
soccer:547281.head: Will play against Celta Vigo

soccer:547282.body: Tchouameni (strain) was spotted participating in Real Madrid's full team training session Thursday after withdrawing from France's national team due to a muscular issue and is likely to be available for Saturday's La Liga clash against Celta Vigo, the club posted .
soccer:547282.head: Trains fully Thursday

soccer:547283.body: Xhaka (calf) was absent from Sunderland's team training session Thursday as he continues recovering from a muscular injury, leaving him doubtful for Saturday's Premier League clash against Aston Villa, according to Keith Downie of Sky Sports.
soccer:547283.head: Misses training Thursday

soccer:547284.body: Brobbey (muscular) did not participate in Sunderland's team training session Thursday, casting further doubt on his availability for Saturday's Premier League encounter against Aston Villa, according to Keith Downie of Sky Sports.
soccer:547284.head: Absent from team training

soccer:547285.body: Miller (lower body) has fully recovered from his recent injury and is available for New England Revolution's upcoming MLS Cup Playoffs clash against Philadelphia, according to coach Marko Mitrovic, per Seth Man of Blazing Musket. "Just purely from a high performance and health perspective, Peyton is good to go."
soccer:547285.head: Cleared to return for playoffs

soccer:547286.body: Harrison (quad) has resumed full team training ahead of Saturday's MLS Cup Playoffs clash against Philadelphia, although New England Revolution coach Marko Mitrovic remains cautious about his availability, according to Seth Man of Blazing Musket. "We have to be cautious. He's in a very good spot."
soccer:547286.head: In good spot to return

soccer:547287.body: Tchouameni has signed a contract extension with Real Madrid, committing his future to the club until June 2032, the club announced Thursday .
soccer:547287.head: Signs extension through 2032

soccer:547288.body: Anton (muscular) remains questionable for Saturday's Bundesliga clash against Borussia Monchengladbach and will be a late fitness decision, according to coach Niko Kovac . "With Waldi, we need to see over the next couple of days whether he's fit enough."
soccer:547288.head: Late call for Gladbach clash

soccer:547289.body: Guirassy (thigh) will be a game-time decision for Saturday's Bundesliga encounter against Borussia Monchengladbach as he continues working toward full fitness, according to coach Niko Kovac . "With Serhou, we need to see over the next couple of days whether he's fit enough."
soccer:547289.head: Faces late fitness decision

soccer:547290.body: Chukwuemeka (thigh) is a late fitness call for Saturday's Bundesliga encounter against Borussia Monchengladbach as he continues recovering from a muscular injury, according to coach Niko Kovac . "With Chuky, we need to see over the next couple of days whether he's fit enough."
soccer:547290.head: Doubtful for Gladbach game

soccer:547291.body: Abdelmonem (hamstring) has been ruled out for Saturday's Ligue 1 clash against Paris Saint-Germain after returning to Nice on Thursday, according to coach Olivier Pantaloni, per Arthur Fradin of Radio France.
soccer:547291.head: Ruled out against PSG

soccer:547292.body: Sierra (shoulder) resumed working with the ball during an individual training session Thursday as he continues recovering from a right shoulder injury, according to ABC Sevilla .
soccer:547292.head: Resumes ball work in recovery

soccer:547293.body: Garcia (hamstring) has resumed partial team training and remains questionable for Saturday's La Liga clash against Rayo Vallecano, according to coach Benat San Jose, per Union Rayo . "Alvaro and Jozhua have been training partially with the group, and tomorrow will be a key day to assess how both are doing ahead of Saturday."
soccer:547293.head: Questionable against Valencia

soccer:547294.body: Vertrouwd (muscular) has returned to partial team training but remains uncertain for Saturday's La Liga clash against Rayo Vallecano, according to coach Benat San Jose, per Union Rayo . "Alvaro and Jozhua have been training partially with the group, and tomorrow will be a key day to assess how both are doing ahead of Saturday."
soccer:547294.head: Late fitness call

soccer:547295.body: Valentin (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's La Liga clash against Rayo Vallecano despite making significant progress in his recovery, according to coach Benat San Jose . "Oscar will be unavailable. He's improved a lot in recent days, but he still hasn't trained much."
soccer:547295.head: Ruled out despite improving knee

soccer:547299.body: Mickelson (knee) has sustained a medial collateral ligament injury and is expected to miss several weeks, according to coach Vincent Wagner . "Nico has suffered a medial collateral ligament injury. We hope for weeks, not months."
soccer:547299.head: Suffers MCL setback

soccer:547300.body: Pinckert (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's Bundesliga clash against Freiburg after failing to return to team training, according to coach Vincent Wagner . "We are missing Lukas. He didn't train with the team and we will not take risks."
soccer:547300.head: Ruled out against Freiburg

soccer:547301.body: Mitoma (hamstring) is expected to remain sidelined for another two to three weeks as he continues recovering from his injury, according to Brighton chairman Tony Bloom, per Brian Owen of The Argus. "Kaoru will hopefully be back in the next two or three weeks."
soccer:547301.head: Targets return in two to three weeks

soccer:547302.body: Vivian (thigh) is expected to remain sidelined for approximately two more weeks as he continues recovering from a left thigh injury, according to Athletic Club coach Edin Terzic, per Athletic Xtra . "We hope Vivian will be with us in a couple of weeks, but the important thing is that he has already shown he can help us. You've already seen the performances he's given us."
soccer:547302.head: Targets return in few weeks

soccer:547305.body: van Dijk (undisclosed) participated in Liverpool's full team training session Thursday after withdrawing from the Netherlands squad due to a minor fitness issue and is expected to start Sunday's Premier League clash against Manchester United, according to Paul Gorst of the Liverpool Echo.
soccer:547305.head: Expected to start against United

soccer:547306.body: Frimpong (hamstring) resumed full team training with Liverpool on Thursday and is expected to be available for Sunday's Premier League clash against Manchester United, according to Paul Gorst of the Liverpool Echo.
soccer:547306.head: Could return against United

soccer:547307.body: Gravenberch (heel) participated in Liverpool's full team training session Thursday after missing the club's recent matches due to persistent discomfort and is expected to be available for Sunday's Premier League clash against Manchester United, according to Paul Gorst of the Liverpool Echo.
soccer:547307.head: Returns to training ahead of United

soccer:547308.body: Bradley (knee) was absent from Liverpool's team training session Thursday as part of a planned recovery program and remains ruled out for Sunday's Premier League clash against Manchester United, according to Paul Gorst of the Liverpool Echo.
soccer:547308.head: Continues gradual return to training

soccer:547309.body: Leoni (knee) was held out of Liverpool's team training session Thursday as part of his carefully managed rehabilitation and will remain unavailable for Sunday's Premier League clash against Manchester United, according to Paul Gorst of the Liverpool Echo.
soccer:547309.head: Misses training as recovery continues

soccer:547310.body: Mata (muscular) has been ruled out for Sunday's Ligue 1 clash against Lille due to muscular discomfort, according to Lyon coach Carlos Vicens, per Tonic Radio .
soccer:547310.head: Ruled out with muscular discomfort

soccer:547311.body: Namaso (ankle) returned from international duty with significant swelling in his ankle and underwent an MRI, with the results still pending ahead of Saturday's Ligue 1 clash against Monaco, according to coach Will Still . "Danny came back with a fairly swollen ankle. He had an MRI, and we're waiting for the results."
soccer:547311.head: Undergoes MRI on swollen ankle

soccer:547312.body: Makosso is not expected to return from international duty until Friday, leaving limited preparation time ahead of Saturday's Ligue 1 clash against Monaco, according to coach Will Still . "Christ only returns from international duty tomorrow."
soccer:547312.head: Faces late return from international duty

soccer:547313.body: Okoh (knee) has resumed working with Auxerre's squad as he continues recovering from a torn anterior cruciate ligament, according to coach Will Still . "Bryan is starting to feel comfortable with the group again."
soccer:547313.head: Makes progress in ACL recovery

soccer:547314.body: Brobbey (muscular) will miss Saturday's Premier League clash against Aston Villa due to a new muscle injury and will be assessed on a weekly basis, according to coach Regis Le Bris . "It's a new injury for Brian, not a recurrence. We will assess him weekly."
soccer:547314.head: Sidelined with new muscle issue

soccer:547315.body: Xhaka (calf) is expected to remain sidelined for an extended period as he continues recovering from a calf injury, according to coach Regis Le Bris . "Granit will be out a little longer with a calf injury."
soccer:547315.head: Remains sidelined with calf issue

soccer:547316.body: Stach (foot) has resumed training with Leeds United and spent the past week partially integrated into group sessions ahead of Saturday's Premier League clash against Chelsea, according to coach Daniel Farke, per Leeds Live . "Stach had a full week back in training, partly integrated."
soccer:547316.head: In contention for Chelsea clash

soccer:547320.body: Diarra (hamstring) remains sidelined and is scheduled to undergo another assessment in approximately two weeks as he continues recovering from a hamstring injury, according to coach Regis Le Bris .
soccer:547320.head: Set for reassessment in two weeks

soccer:547321.body: Ballard (hamstring) remains sidelined but is targeting a return to training in December as he continues recovering from a hamstring injury, according to coach Regis Le Bris .
soccer:547321.head: Set to resume training in December

soccer:547322.body: Mundle (knee) remains sidelined following meniscus surgery but is on track to resume training in December, according to coach Regis Le Bris .
soccer:547322.head: Targets December training return

soccer:547323.body: Belghali (knee) "could be available versus Napoli, but it will depend on how much he'll be able to practice Friday," coach Ignazio Abate announced.
soccer:547323.head: Questionable for Napoli match

soccer:547324.body: Fortini (groin) "has recovered from a sports hernia, but his conditioning is lacking," coach Ignazio Abate stated.
soccer:547324.head: Shakes off injury

soccer:547326.body: Vlasic (thigh) "will be evaluated in the final training session," coach Ignazio Abate announced.
soccer:547326.head: In doubt for Napoli clash

soccer:547329.body: Thomas (calf) has returned to team training after missing Coventry City's previous match against Everton, although his availability for Saturday's Premier League clash against Crystal Palace remains uncertain, according to coach Frank Lampard, per Coventry Live . "Bobby's training with us, so we'll see how he is for the weekend."
soccer:547329.head: Could return against Palace

soccer:547330.body: Wright (thigh) has begun participating in portions of Coventry City's team warm-ups as he continues recovering from a long-term injury, according to coach Frank Lampard, per Coventry Live . "Haji was outside for the first time with us last week doing bits of the warm-up and the early parts of training, so he's progressing well."
soccer:547330.head: Steps up rehabilitation

soccer:547331.body: Amenda (calf) has resumed individual training on the pitch and could return to team activities within the next two to three weeks, according to coach Frank Lampard, per Coventry Live . "He's out on the pitch training on his own at the minute, not with us. We'll play it as we see it over the next two to three weeks, and we're hopeful that he'll be involved in that sort of range."
soccer:547331.head: Targets return within three weeks

soccer:547332.body: Yirenkyi (undisclosed) has returned from international duty with Ghana but remains uncertain for Saturday's Premier League clash against Crystal Palace due to a fitness concern, according to coach Frank Lampard, per Coventry Live . "He's back, and we'll have to see how he is for the weekend."
soccer:547332.head: Remains doubtful for Saturday

soccer:547333.body: Joelinton (thigh) remains sidelined ahead of Saturday's Premier League clash against Arsenal, with Newcastle awaiting specialist feedback to determine his recovery timeline, according to coach Matthias Jaissle . "We will get feedback from the specialists, we will find out how long Joe will be out. We will get an update and hope he is back soon."
soccer:547333.head: Awaiting specialist assessment

soccer:547335.body: Schlager (hamstring) remains doubtful for Saturday's Premier League clash against Bournemouth after missing Austria's international fixtures due to muscular discomfort, according to coach Oliver Glasner . "Schlager couldn't play because he felt his hamstring and is a doubt for Saturday."
soccer:547335.head: Doubtful for Bournemouth clash

soccer:547336.body: Hudson-Odoi (undisclosed) sustained an injury during the international break and has been ruled out for Saturday's Premier League clash against Bournemouth, according to coach Oliver Glasner . "Hudson-Odoi got injured in the international break so he will definitely miss the game."
soccer:547336.head: Ruled out against Bournemouth

soccer:547337.body: Williams (ankle) is doubtful for Saturday's Premier League clash against Bournemouth after experiencing renewed ankle discomfort during international duty with Wales, according to coach Oliver Glasner . "He had the same problems with his ankle, so he is a doubt."
soccer:547337.head: Doubtful with ankle problem

soccer:547342.body: Bulatovic (neck) has been ruled out for Saturday's Ligue 1 clash against Toulouse despite making significant progress in his recovery from a heavy fall during international duty with Montenegro, according to coach Didier Digard, per Lensois .
soccer:547342.head: Ruled out against Toulouse

soccer:547343.body: Sima (thigh) is making good progress in his recovery and is likely to return to Lens' matchday squad for Saturday's Ligue 1 clash against Toulouse, according to coach Didier Digard, per Lensois . "Bringing players of this quality back into the squad is good for everyone."
soccer:547343.head: Could return against Toulouse

soccer:549128.body: Mazzocchi (thigh) "has worked with the group in recent days and will be selected for Friday's match," coach Davide Nicola announced.
soccer:549128.head: Available against Bologna

soccer:549129.body: Basic (thigh) "has trained fully for a few days in a row this week and will be an option Friday," coach Davide Nicola relayed.
soccer:549129.head: Fit for Bologna clash

soccer:549130.body: Correia (thigh) "won't play Friday, but perhaps there'll be some positive updates about him next week. He has had a few different injuries already, and we are trying to get him right for good," coach Davide Nicola announced.
soccer:549130.head: Out again versus Bologna

soccer:549131.body: Heggem (not injury-related) has been named in Bologna's squad list to face Venezia on Friday.
soccer:549131.head: Called up for Venezia tilt

soccer:549132.body: Lacroix (hamstring) remains sidelined for Friday's Premier League clash against Nottingham Forest despite making progress in his recovery, according to coach Xabi Alonso . "It's one less week than from the last game. So we are closer in his recovery, but not for this game."
soccer:549132.head: Making progress in recovery

soccer:549133.body: Henry (hip/quad) remains unavailable for Saturday's Premier League clash against Manchester United as he continues recovering from his recent physical problems, according to coach Keith Andrews .
soccer:549133.head: Remains sidelined with hip problem

soccer:549134.body: Milambo (knee) is progressing toward a return to Brentford's first-team squad before Christmas after completing 45 minutes for the B team against Hull City U21s, according to coach Keith Andrews . "They'll continue that over the next week or two and then hopefully they can gatecrash the first-team squad."
soccer:549134.head: Closing in on first-team return

soccer:549135.body: Dasilva (hamstring) could return to Brentford's first-team squad before Christmas after completing 45 minutes for the B team against Hull City U21s, according to coach Keith Andrews . "They're building the fitness level that's needed to come into the first-team space, but they're training with us pretty consistently. [...] They'll continue that over the next week or two and then hopefully they can gatecrash the first-team squad."
soccer:549135.head: Targets return before Christmas

soccer:549136.body: Awoniyi (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's Premier League clash against Leeds United after sustaining a significant ankle injury against Crystal Palace, according to coach Frank Lampard, per Coventry Live . "Taiwo got a significant injury in his ankle area. [...] We don't know the significance of it yet but he won't be available for the weekend."
soccer:549136.head: Suffers significant ankle setback

soccer:549137.body: Yirenkyi (undisclosed) could return for Saturday's Premier League encounter against Leeds United after missing the previous match against Crystal Palace, according to coach Frank Lampard, per Coventry Live . "We're hoping Caleb can be involved in this game, he got his injury on international duty, but we'll have to see."
soccer:549137.head: Could return against Leeds

soccer:549138.body: Wright (thigh) remains several weeks away from returning to competitive action despite making progress in training, according to coach Frank Lampard, per Coventry Live . "With Haji he's working towards being fit, so he's going to be a few weeks away from being available for us."
soccer:549138.head: Still weeks away from return

soccer:549139.body: Le Guen (fibula) is increasing his individual training workload but remains approximately one week away from returning to collective training, according to coach Julien Lachuer . "He's continuing his individual work, with a bit more running and ball work, but still on his own. He has another week to complete these steps before returning to team training."
soccer:549139.head: Still a week away from team training

soccer:549140.body: Chardonnet (calf) has resumed team training but remains short of match fitness and will play a maximum of 45 minutes in a Challenge Espoirs fixture, according to coach Julien Lachuer . "Brendan has resumed team training this week. He's still a little short of being ready for competitive action. That's why we're having him play part of tomorrow's Challenge Espoirs match to help him regain his match sharpness. He won't play more than 45 minutes."
soccer:549140.head: Set for limited youth-team appearance

soccer:549142.body: Uzun (illness) remains uncertain for Saturday's Bundesliga clash against Stuttgart despite returning to team training Wednesday, according to coach Adi Hutter . "The cold lasted a little longer. [...] He's naturally feeling the effects. We'll see whether he's ready for the weekend. [...] The decision will be made on Friday."
soccer:549142.head: Facing late fitness decision

soccer:549143.body: Njinmah (muscular) is unlikely to feature in Friday's Bundesliga clash against Borussia Monchengladbach after missing the last two training sessions, according to coach Daniel Thioune . "Justin hasn't been on the pitch for the last two days. If he trains tomorrow morning without discomfort, he's an option for the evening. But right now, I'm very skeptical."
soccer:549143.head: Doubtful after muscular setback

soccer:549144.body: Weiser (thigh) is expected to return to Werder Bremen's squad for Friday's Bundesliga encounter against Borussia Monchengladbach if he completes his final fitness assessment without discomfort, according to coach Daniel Thioune . "Weiser has fully completed the last two training days. If he has no problems on Friday morning either, he will return to the matchday squad."
soccer:549144.head: Facing final fitness assessment

soccer:549145.body: Grull (calf) will miss Friday's Bundesliga clash against Borussia Monchengladbach but could resume partial team training next week, according to coach Daniel Thioune . "We might be able to partially reintegrate him next week, or the week after at the latest. [...] I would say he'll be back in the squad this year, possibly as early as next week."
soccer:549145.head: Could resume training next week

soccer:549146.body: Ndiaye (groin) remains unavailable for Friday's Bundesliga encounter against Borussia Monchengladbach as he continues recovering from his injury, according to coach Daniel Thioune .
soccer:549146.head: Season debut remains on hold

soccer:549147.body: Alvero (calf) has been ruled out for Friday's Bundesliga clash against Borussia Monchengladbach despite recently resuming training activities, according to coach Daniel Thioune .
soccer:549147.head: Ruled out despite recent progress

soccer:549149.body: Baack (illness) is expected to be available for Saturday's Bundesliga clash against Schalke 04 despite cutting Wednesday's training session short due to a cold, according to coach Ralf Kettemann .
soccer:549149.head: Set to face Schalke despite illness

soccer:549150.body: Ulrich (illness) is expected to be available for Saturday's Bundesliga encounter against Schalke 04 after recently missing training due to stomach problems, with Paderborn reporting few availability concerns, according to coach Ralf Kettemann .
soccer:549150.head: Expected to be available Saturday

soccer:549151.body: Hoffmeier (thigh) is expected to remain unavailable for Saturday's Bundesliga encounter against Schalke 04 as he continues recovering from a muscular injury, according to the club .
soccer:549151.head: Remains out with thigh problem

soccer:549153.body: Savio (hamstring) is expected to miss several weeks after suffering a recurrence of his hamstring injury during Saturday's Premier League victory over Ipswich Town, according to Guillermo Rai of The Athletic .
soccer:549153.head: Faces another spell on sidelines

soccer:549157.body: Kleindienst (muscular) could return to the matchday squad for Friday's Bundesliga clash against Werder Bremen after completing team training without setbacks, according to coach Alexander Blessin . "Tim has had a tough run with injuries over the last months. [...] It could be the case that he's an option for the final 10 to 15 minutes, depending on what we need."
soccer:549157.head: Could make bench against Bremen

soccer:549160.body: Bolin (muscular) has resumed full team training without setbacks and could return to Borussia Monchengladbach's squad for Friday's Bundesliga encounter against Werder Bremen, according to coach Alexander Blessin . "Kleindienst and Bolin returned to team training this week and didn't report any discomfort after the sessions. We will need to wait and see whether they will be able to return in time to face Bremen."
soccer:549160.head: Back in contention for Bremen clash

soccer:549161.body: Hashioka (undisclosed) remains unavailable for Friday's Bundesliga encounter against Werder Bremen as he continues recovering from an unspecified physical problem, according to coach Alexander Blessin . "Hashioka still needs some time before he'll be ready to return."
soccer:549161.head: Still needs time to recover

soccer:549162.body: Viery suffered a left biceps femoris strain and will be re-evaluated in the coming weeks, Fiorentina announced.
soccer:549162.head: Will skip a few matches

soccer:549163.body: Ullrich (collarbone) is making encouraging progress in his recovery from a fractured collarbone, according to coach Alexander Blessin .
soccer:549163.head: Making steady recovery progress

soccer:549164.body: Leszczynski (knee) has completed several individual training sessions on the pitch without experiencing any setbacks as he continues recovering from his knee injury, according to coach Alexander Blessin . "Leszczynski has completed several individual sessions on the pitch and also didn't react negatively to the intensity, so things are looking good with him as well."
soccer:549164.head: Progresses through individual training

soccer:549165.body: Hack (muscular) is unlikely to be available for Friday's Bundesliga clash against Werder Bremen due to a minor muscle problem, according to coach Alexander Blessin . "Hack will likely be unavailable on Friday with a minor muscular issue, but we'll have to wait and see if there are any further developments in his case."
soccer:549165.head: Unlikely to feature against Bremen

soccer:549169.body: Schallenberg (leg) remains unavailable for Saturday's Bundesliga clash against Paderborn, with Schalke expected to rely largely on the same squad as last weekend, according to coach Miron Muslic .
soccer:549169.head: Still limited to individual training

soccer:549170.body: Vozar (thigh) will miss Saturday's Bundesliga encounter against Paderborn as he continues working toward full fitness, with Schalke retaining most of its available squad from the previous fixture, according to coach Miron Muslic .
soccer:549170.head: Still recovering from thigh problem

soccer:549172.body: Sangui (hamstring) is available for Friday's Ligue 1 clash against Brest, although his workload will be carefully managed, according to coach Liam Rosenior . "We have no injured players. We'll have to be careful with Sangui's workload."
soccer:549172.head: Fit but workload to be managed

soccer:549173.body: Kroupi (illness) has been left out of Bournemouth's squad for Thursday's Europa League clash against Celta Vigo after developing a fever overnight, according to coach Marco Rose , per Jordan Clark .
soccer:549173.head: Illness forces late withdrawal

soccer:549189.body: Bourabaa (ankle) has signed a contract extension with Le Mans through June 2029 while continuing his rehabilitation at Clairefontaine following ankle surgery, the club announced .
soccer:549189.head: Extends contract through 2029

soccer:549192.body: Saliba (ankle) underwent surgery Wednesday in Madrid to address ligament damage in his left ankle, according to the club .
soccer:549192.head: Undergoes ankle surgery

soccer:549193.body: Adorante (back) has been called up for Friday's game versus Bologna and will be available for the first time this season.
soccer:549193.head: Option for Bologna match

soccer:549194.body: Taylor will be absent for Saturday's clash with Torino due to muscle fatigue, Sky Italy reported.
soccer:549194.head: Will skip Torino tilt

soccer:549195.body: Diakite received a red card in the 22nd minute of Thursday's Europa League clash against Celta Vigo and will be suspended for Bournemouth's next European fixture against Viktoria Plzen on Dec. 10.
soccer:549195.head: Sent off against Celta Vigo

soccer:549196.body: Kaba sustained a low-grade right biceps femoris strain in training, Lecce announced.
soccer:549196.head: Suffers thigh injury

soccer:549198.body: Methalie is absent from Thursday's Europa League clash against Jagiellonia due to illness, according to the club .
soccer:549198.head: Misses out with illness

soccer:549199.body: Sorloth has been diagnosed with a muscle injury in his right leg following Wednesday's Champions League clash against Viking FK and will undergo physiotherapy and rehabilitation work, the club announced .
soccer:549199.head: Diagnosed with muscle problem

soccer:549200.body: Eccles (ankle) has undergone a minor operation and will remain sidelined for an unspecified period, according to coach Frank Lampard . "Eccles has unfortunately had to have a small operation on his ankle, so he will be out for a period of time."
soccer:549200.head: Undergoes ankle surgery

soccer:549201.body: Amenda (calf) could resume partial team training next week as he continues recovering from his muscular problem, according to coach Frank Lampard . "Aurèle is hopefully training with us maybe partial but progressing next week."
soccer:549201.head: Targets partial training next week

soccer:549202.body: Woolfenden (knee) has resumed partial team training but remains several weeks away from regaining match fitness, according to coach Frank Lampard . "Woolfy has started training with us - in, out, in, out, but on the pitch with us. He trained trained part of the session today so that will be a progression of a few weeks to get up to match fitness where his injury has sort of broken his pre-season."
soccer:549202.head: Resumes partial team training

soccer:549203.body: Mason-Clark (knee) returned to team training Thursday and could be included in Saturday's Premier League squad against Leeds United, according to coach Frank Lampard . "Ephron's trained today and will hopefully be in the squad."
soccer:549203.head: Could return Saturday

soccer:549204.body: Diop was forced off in the 64th minute of Thursday's Conference League clash against Hearts after appearing to sustain an injury, according to the club .
soccer:549204.head: Forced off with knock

soccer:549206.body: Bidstrup (foot) is absent from Thursday's Europa League squad against Lillestrom due to a minor foot problem, according to the club .
soccer:549206.head: Ruled out with foot problem

soccer:549208.body: Bermont will miss Saturday's Ligue 1 clash against Lens due to a clause in his loan agreement preventing him from facing his parent club, according to Ouest France .
soccer:549208.head: Ruled out against parent club

soccer:549211.body: Burger was forced off during Thursday's Europa League clash against Sturm Graz after suffering an apparent rib injury, according to the club .
soccer:549211.head: Forced off with rib problem

soccer:549212.body: Alderete was forced off during Thursday's Europa League clash against Jagiellonia after appearing to sustain an injury following an awkward fall, according to the club .
soccer:549212.head: Forced off after awkward fall

soccer:549213.body: Elloumi could miss the second game of the best-of-three series against Real Salt Lake due to a foot injury, per the MLS Player Status Report.
soccer:549213.head: Questionable with foot concern

soccer:549214.body: Martin received a red card during Thursday's UEFA Europa League loss to Crystal Palace.
soccer:549214.head: Sent off in Europa League

soccer:549215.body: O'Riley made the starting XI but was forced to leave at halftime in Thursday's UEFA Conference League win over Universitatea Craiova following a blow to his right ankle, about which manager Fabian Hurzeler said "It did not look good, it is very swollen. We will have to see," per Derren Howard of Sussex World .
soccer:549215.head: Exits game with swollen ankle

soccer:549216.body: Adekugbe (hamstring) doesn't appear on Vancouver's section of the MLS Player Status Report for Friday's Round One Game 2 against Real Salt Lake, suggesting he's in contention to play.
soccer:549216.head: Off injury report

soccer:549218.body: Ayala (strain) remains sidelined for the second playoffs match against Columbus Crew, the league reported Thursday.
soccer:549218.head: Out for second straight game

soccer:549219.body: Reguilon remains absent and is now listed with a hamstring injury, a more specific designation than the lower-body label he carried previously, per the MLS injury report for Friday's visit to Columbus.
soccer:549219.head: Listed with hamstring issue

soccer:549220.body: Alderete's substitution in the first half of Thursday's Europa League game versus Jagiellonia was because he felt ill, as coach Regis Le Bris commented that Alderete "felt unwell. I don't know exactly what happened. We'll assess him this evening and we'll see what happens," per the club's official website.
soccer:549220.head: Illness behind early exit

soccer:549221.body: White (quadriceps) is sidelined for Friday's clash against Real Salt Lake in the Round One playoffs series.
soccer:549221.head: Officially ruled out

soccer:549222.body: Andrada (knee) underwent arthroscopic surgery to repair his meniscus injury, Monterrey announced Thursday. The club did not give a recovery timeline, but TUDN's Vladimir Garcia reports he could be out up to six weeks.
soccer:549222.head: Undergoes meniscus surgery

soccer:549227.body: Pereira missed Wednesday's playoffs opener against Atlas with an undisclosed injury, according to PressPort .
soccer:549227.head: Out Wednesday due to injury

soccer:549237.body: Zagadou (knee) remains in the rehabilitation phase but is gradually reintegrating into group training sessions, according to the club .
soccer:549237.head: Gradually resumes team training

soccer:549239.body: Cresswell is expected to be ineligible for Sunday's Ligue 1 clash against Toulouse due to the terms of his loan agreement with obligation to buy with his parent club Toulouse, according to Les Violets .
soccer:549239.head: Likely ineligible against Toulouse

soccer:549241.body: Kondogbia (undisclosed) missed Thursday's 1-0 victory over Levski Sofia after experiencing tendon pain during the final training session before the encounter, according to coach Bruno Genesio, per Luke Entwistle of Get French Football News.
soccer:549241.head: Dealing with tendon pain

soccer:549243.body: McKenzie (hamstring) was still absent from team training Wednesday and remains a doubt for Sunday's Ligue 1 clash against Rennes, according to Les Violets .
soccer:549243.head: Still absent from team training

soccer:549244.body: Rodri (hamstring) is expected to return to contention for Sunday's La Liga clash against Deportivo, with coach Hansi Flick hoping to give him some minutes, according to Didac Peyret of Diario Sport.
soccer:549244.head: Closing in on competitive return

soccer:549245.body: Zaccagni (quad) has been training regularly this week and will be in contention to start Saturday, Corriere dello Sport reported.
soccer:549245.head: Fit for Torino match

soccer:549250.body: Burger suffered an apparent abdominal muscle strain during Thursday's 3-1 Europa League victory over Sturm Graz and is expected to be sidelined for an extended period, according to coach Christian Ilzer . "Wouter, who is an absolute cornerstone of our game, appears to have suffered an abdominal muscle strain. He will probably be out for a prolonged period."
soccer:549250.head: Facing extended spell on sidelines

soccer:549253.body: Ede (hamstring) is progressing slower than initially anticipated in his recovery and remains out for the time being, according to coach Antonio Hidalgo, per Riazor . "He's progressing more slowly than we expected. Given the discomfort he experienced when trying to return, we're being cautious."
soccer:549253.head: Recovery progressing slower than expected

soccer:549254.body: Mendy (leg) will be available off the bench for Saturday's La Liga clash against Alaves, according to coach Jose Mourinho, per Diario AS . "Mendy will be on the bench tomorrow, which is good news for us. He can play."
soccer:549254.head: Will be on bench Saturday

soccer:549255.body: Alexander-Arnold (illness) has been ruled out for Saturday's La Liga clash against Alaves, according to coach Jose Mourinho, per Diario AS . "Trent is sick. He is out tomorrow."
soccer:549255.head: Ruled out with illness

soccer:549256.body: Rodrygo (knee) continues to make progress in his rehabilitation but is not expected to feature against Arsenal in the UCL or in any remaining La Liga fixtures in 2026, according to coach Jose Mourinho, per Diario AS . "He is in a pretty good place. He is working very hard, he's really shifted his mindset. Before, it seemed like he had sort of settled into the reality of his injury, but now he's putting in a lot of effort. I don't see him playing against Arsenal, nor do I see him featuring in any league matches before the end of the year."
soccer:549256.head: Not expected back until 2027

soccer:549257.body: Olise (foot) has been ruled out for Saturday's Bundesliga clash against Hamburger SV, according to coach Vincent Kompany . "Michael will not be involved."
soccer:549257.head: Ruled out against Hamburg

soccer:549258.body: Foulquier (knee) has yet to feature in La Liga this season and remains absent from team training as he continues working on his fitness, according to Tribuna VCF .
soccer:549258.head: Still building up fitness

soccer:549260.body: Smith Rowe (hip) has been ruled out for Sunday's Premier League clash against Bournemouth due to lingering discomfort, according to coach Alvaro Arbeloa, per Jack Kelly of Fulhamish. "ESR still with some pain, so he's not available."
soccer:549260.head: Remains unavailable

soccer:549261.body: Andersen (undisclosed) has been ruled out for Sunday's Premier League clash against Bournemouth due to a fitness issue, according to coach Alvaro Arbeloa, per Jack Kelly of Fulhamish. "Joa came back from the break with some issues, so he is also not available."
soccer:549261.head: Unavailable against Bournemouth

soccer:549265.body: Fernandes (illness) was held out of Friday's team training session as a precaution and will be a late call for Saturday's Premier League clash against Brentford, the club announced .
soccer:549265.head: Rested as precaution Friday

soccer:549266.body: Maguire (undisclosed) picked up an injury during Wednesday's UCL clash against Sporting CP but Manchester United remain hopeful he will be available for Saturday's Premier League encounter against Brentford, according to Rob Dawson and Mark Ogden of ESPN .
soccer:549266.head: Fitness concern ahead of Brentford

soccer:549269.body: Ceballos (hamstring) resumed full team training Friday and will be an option for Saturday's La Liga encounter against Rayo Vallecano, according to Zona Mixta .
soccer:549269.head: Option again after training in full

soccer:549271.body: Lo Celso (knee) remained absent from team training Friday and has been ruled out for Saturday's La Liga clash against Rayo Vallecano, according to Zona Mixta .
soccer:549271.head: Ruled out against Rayo Vallecano

soccer:549272.body: Marcao (quadriceps) remains unavailable for Sunday's La Liga clash against Real Sociedad despite resuming partial team training, according to coach Luis Plaza . "Marcao is starting to train, but he's only beginning some activation exercises and participating in a small portion of the session."
soccer:549272.head: Not ready to return

soccer:549273.body: Bernal (undisclosed) sat out Friday's team training session due to minor physical discomfort stemming from an accumulated workload but is expected to resume collective training Saturday ahead of Sunday's La Liga clash against Deportivo La Coruna, according to Carlos Monfort of Diario Sport.
soccer:549273.head: Misses training with minor discomfort

soccer:549274.body: Christensen (calf) has yet to resume collective training and remains unlikely to feature in Sunday's La Liga clash against Deportivo La Coruna, according to Carlos Monfort of Diario Sport.
soccer:549274.head: Still training individually

soccer:549275.body: Rodriguez (leg) was unable to complete Friday's training session due to a minor strain in his right leg, making him a doubt for Sunday's La Liga clash against Osasuna, according to Tribuna VCF .
soccer:549275.head: Suffers minor muscular setback

soccer:549276.body: Aguado (ankle) will be a late call for Saturday's La Liga clash against Atletico Madrid despite having resumed team training, according to coach Martin Anselmi .
soccer:549276.head: Late call against Atletico Madrid

soccer:549277.body: Houary (ankle) will be assessed ahead of Saturday's La Liga encounter against Atletico Madrid, with a decision on his availability set to be made closer to kickoff, according to coach Martin Anselmi .
soccer:549277.head: Late fitness decision

soccer:549278.body: Nianzou (muscular) is expected to remain sidelined until the end of 2026 and could return for the Jan. 3 clash against Strasbourg, according to coach Davide Ancelotti . "Muscular injury, we might see him against Strasbourg."
soccer:549278.head: Could return in January

soccer:549279.body: Donkor (undisclosed) is currently sidelined with an injury and has no established return date, according to coach Stephane Dumont, per Jonathan Sottas of NRJ.
soccer:549279.head: Sidelined with undisclosed injury

soccer:549280.body: Gozzi (hamstring) continues to recover from his injury and could return to action before Christmas, according to coach Stephane Dumont, per Jonathan Sottas of NRJ.
soccer:549280.head: Could return before Christmas

soccer:549281.body: Titi will undergo surgery on the upper part of his quadriceps next week and is expected to be sidelined for a prolonged period, according to coach Stephane Dumont, per Jonathan Sottas of NRJ.
soccer:549281.head: Set for quadriceps surgery

soccer:549284.body: Ceballos (back) will not be available for Saturday's La Liga clash against Rayo Vallecano, according to coach Manuel Pellegrini . "Dani is also recovering from a spinal issue, so he isn't in condition to play tomorrow either."
soccer:549284.head: Ruled out with new back issue

soccer:549285.body: Akhomach (muscle) resumed team training Friday and could be an option for Sunday's La Liga clash against Celta Vigo, according to coach Inigo Perez .
soccer:549285.head: Late fitness decision

soccer:549286.body: Foyth (muscular) participated in Friday's team training session and could be available for Sunday's La Liga encounter against Celta Vigo, according to coach Inigo Perez .
soccer:549286.head: Could return against Celta Vigo

soccer:549287.body: Moreno (muscular) took part in team training sessions since a few days and could make his return in Sunday's La Liga clash against Celta Vigo, according to coach Inigo Perez .
soccer:549287.head: In contention for Sunday

soccer:549291.body: Sannadi (hamstring) is progressing slightly ahead of schedule and could resume team training within the next two weeks, potentially returning for the Dec. 13 clash against Deportivo La Coruna, according to coach Edin Terzic . "With Maroan, we're being very careful and cautious because of his injury history, but he's a little ahead of schedule."
soccer:549291.head: Ahead of recovery schedule

soccer:549295.body: Ratkov (undisclosed) has been ruled out for Friday's La Liga clash against Racing Santander, according to A Punt Esports .
soccer:549295.head: Unavailable against Racing Santander

soccer:549296.body: Vaz has returned to Hull City after a police incident in France involving a rental car was resolved but is not expected to feature in Sunday's Premier League clash against Crystal Palace, according to Barry Cooper of Hull Live.
soccer:549296.head: Unlikely to feature Sunday

soccer:549297.body: Yamal (ankle) was spotted participating in Friday's full team training session and will be an option for Sunday's La Liga clash against Deportivo La Coruna, the club posted .
soccer:549297.head: Ready to return Sunday

soccer:549298.body: Sy has suffered a meniscus tear in his right knee and is expected to be sidelined for at least six weeks, with a potential absence of up to six months, according to coach Will Still . "For Lamine, the best-case scenario would be a six-week absence, and the worst would be six months."
soccer:549298.head: Faces lengthy absence

soccer:549299.body: Namaso (ankle) remains sidelined and is expected to miss another two to three weeks due to persistent swelling, according to coach Will Still . "Danny's ankle is still quite swollen, and I think it will take another two to three weeks."
soccer:549299.head: Out for several more weeks

soccer:549300.body: Ansah (back) has resumed team training but will need additional time to rebuild his match fitness, according to coach Sergej Jakirovic . "Good news for us, Ansah is training with us. Of course he needs time after not playing during three months, but he looks good. We have to be careful with him."
soccer:549300.head: Back in team training

soccer:549301.body: Vaz's future at Hull City remains uncertain as the club is discussing his situation with Roma following his recent trip to France, according to coach Sergej Jakirovic . "The club is dealing with this situation with Roma, for me it is an unacceptable behavior because I have to deal with 27 players in the building."
soccer:549301.head: Loan future in serious doubt

soccer:549302.body: Hughes (abdomen) could be included in the matchday squad for Sunday's Premier League clash against Crystal Palace, according to coach Sergej Jakirovic, per Barry Cooper of Hull Live.
soccer:549302.head: Could make squad Sunday

soccer:549303.body: Munoz (knee) missed Friday's team training session and will be a late fitness decision for Sunday's Premier League derby against Everton, according to coach Andoni Iraola . "Munoz, good news after assessment but has a big knock, not trained today but wants to try tomorrow. I cannot tell you right now."
soccer:549303.head: Late fitness decision for derby

soccer:549304.body: Gakpo (calf) remains ruled out for Sunday's Premier League derby against Everton and is facing an estimated recovery period of two to three weeks from the time of his injury and will target a return around mid-December, according to coach Andoni Iraola . "Gakpo definitely not. Muscle injury. Gakpo, this is normally two or three weeks. He did it against Germany. I don't like timelines with injuries, but normally you have to give it time to heal."
soccer:549304.head: Facing two-to-three-week recovery

soccer:549305.body: Semenyo (knee) is nearing a return to action and has resumed work on the pitch, according to coach Enzo Maresca . "Antoine is quite close [to returning]. He is already on the pitch - he is very close, next week, I hope."
soccer:549305.head: Could return next week

soccer:549307.body: Gravenberch (heel) remains a doubt for Sunday's Premier League derby against Everton as he continues to deal with persistent pain, according to coach Andoni Iraola . "It's going to be difficult. I cannot say no [for Sunday]. But it's difficult, he is dealing with this situation. Important thing is he is back with no pain to play as free as possible."
soccer:549307.head: Still doubtful for Merseyside derby

soccer:549308.body: Fernandes (illness) will have his condition assessed Saturday morning before a final decision is made regarding his availability against Brentford, according to coach Mauricio Pochettino . "Yes, we don't know. He's affected by a virus from Portugal. He finished the game a little bit with a problem, and, today, he cannot be part of the training session. We'll see. We are going to see during the day and tomorrow, how he wakes up, and we'll see. We're not going to take any risks, because you know when this type of situation happens, you don't feel [you can]. We are going to pay attention but, sti
soccer:549308.head: Decision expected Saturday morning

soccer:549309.body: Alderete (illness) was assessed Friday and is doing fine after experiencing dizziness during Thursday's Europa League clash against Jagiellonia, according to coach Regis Le Bris . "He's been assessed this morning and he's fine."
soccer:549309.head: Cleared after dizziness

soccer:549310.body: Mundle (knee) has resumed running on the pitch but remains some distance from returning to competitive action, according to coach Regis Le Bris . "Romaine and Ballard are running on the pitch, but we won't rush the process."
soccer:549310.head: Resumes running outdoors

soccer:549311.body: Baleba (hamstring) is facing an estimated recovery period of 10 to 12 weeks from the time of his injury against Roma on Nov. 3, according to coach Mauricio Pochettino, per Simon Stone of BBC Sport. "Baleba was injured against Roma, medical people were talking about 10-12 weeks."
soccer:549311.head: Facing 10-to-12-week absence

soccer:549312.body: Ballard (hamstring) has resumed running on the pitch as he continues recovering from his muscular problem, according to coach Regis Le Bris . "Romaine and Ballard are running on the pitch, but we won't rush the process."
soccer:549312.head: Back running on pitch

soccer:549313.body: Rashford (hip) has resumed on-field training and is feeling considerably better as he continues working toward a competitive return, according to coach Mauricio Pochettino, per Simon Stone of BBC Sport. "Marcus is on the field, starting to feel much better."
soccer:549313.head: Makes encouraging recovery progress

soccer:549314.body: Methalie (illness) remains uncertain for Sunday's Premier League clash against Tottenham after missing Thursday's Europa League encounter against Jagiellonia, according to coach Regis Le Bris . "At the minute we have a few players like that. I hope they will be fine for this weekend."
soccer:549314.head: Battling illness ahead of Spurs

soccer:549315.body: Xhaka (calf) remains sidelined for Sunday's Premier League clash against Tottenham, with Sunderland taking a cautious approach to his recovery, according to coach Regis Le Bris . "Brian and Granit want to play as soon as possible, but if we can't sustain the rest of the season it doesn't make sense."
soccer:549315.head: Return still being managed

soccer:549317.body: Brobbey (muscular) remains unavailable for Sunday's Premier League clash against Tottenham despite making progress in his recovery, according to coach Regis Le Bris . "Brian and Granit want to play as soon as possible, but if we can't sustain the rest of the season it doesn't make sense."
soccer:549317.head: Remains sidelined with muscle problem

soccer:549318.body: Adarabioyo (calf) resumed team training Friday and will be a late fitness call for Sunday's Premier League clash against Sunderland, according to coach Roberto De Zerbi . "Tosin started today with us, I don't know, tomorrow we analyse the situation."
soccer:549318.head: Late fitness call for Sunday

soccer:549319.body: Bergvall (illness) is a doubt for Sunday's Premier League clash against Sunderland, according to coach Roberto De Zerbi . "Lucas is sick, I don't know if he's available to play."
soccer:549319.head: Doubtful due to illness

soccer:549320.body: Mudryk (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's Premier League clash against Sunderland as he continues his recovery, according to coach Roberto De Zerbi . "Mudryk is still out."
soccer:549320.head: Remains unavailable

soccer:549325.body: De Bruyne practiced on the side Friday due to muscle fatigue, Napoli announced.
soccer:549325.head: Picks up ailment

soccer:549326.body: Mitoma (hamstring) remains unavailable for Sunday's Premier League clash against Newcastle United but is expected to resume team training within the next one to two weeks, according to coach Fabian Hurzeler, per Derren Howard of Sussex Express. "Kaoru won't be available. That's what I can say. But I'm quite positive that all the other players will be available. Like I said a few weeks ago, we have to be patient with him. He's getting really close, so I think in the next one or two weeks he'll be back training with the team. That's very positive."
soccer:549326.head: Nearing return to team training

soccer:549327.body: Ostigard "isn't in condition to play against Inter due to a severe case of flu," coach Daniele De Rossi announced.
soccer:549327.head: Ruled out for Inter clash

soccer:549328.body: Boscagli (illness) is expected to be available for Sunday's Premier League clash against Newcastle United, according to coach Fabian Hurzeler, per Derren Howard of Sussex Express. "But I'm quite positive that all the other players will be available."
soccer:549328.head: Expected back against Newcastle

soccer:549329.body: Hadjam (undisclosed) is on track to be available for Sunday's Premier League encounter against Newcastle United, according to coach Fabian Hurzeler, per Derren Howard of Sussex Express. "But I'm quite positive that all the other players will be available."
soccer:549329.head: Likely to return Sunday

soccer:549330.body: Cash (concussion) is available for Saturday's Premier League clash against Ipswich Town after completing his recovery, according to coach Unai Emery . "Coming back is Matty."

soccer:549331.head: Remains on the shelf

soccer:549332.body: Ruggeri (hamstring) remains unavailable for Saturday's Premier League clash against Ipswich Town but is nearing a return to action, according to coach Unai Emery . "Still out is Ruggeri, he is close but not yet."
soccer:549332.head: Closing in on return

soccer:549333.body: Tzimas (knee) could be included in the matchday squad for Sunday's Premier League clash against Newcastle United, according to coach Fabian Hurzeler, per Derren Howard of Sussex Express. "But I'm quite positive that all the other players will be available."
soccer:549333.head: Could make long-awaited comeback

soccer:549334.body: Ngonge (undisclosed) "has a shot to return next week," coach Ivan Juric stated.
soccer:549334.head: Sidelined for Roma clash

soccer:549335.body: Onana (knee) remains sidelined as he continues recovering from his long-term injury, with a potential return targeted for the spring, according to coach Unai Emery .

soccer:549336.head: Questionable for Roma game

soccer:549338.body: Ebosse was a late scratch for the Bologna game and is doubtful for the Fiorentina one due to an ankle issue, Diario FVG reported.

soccer:549339.head: Absent against Lazio

soccer:549340.body: Musiala has been diagnosed with a muscle injury in his right thigh and will be sidelined for an indefinite period, according to the club .
soccer:549340.head: Suffers fresh muscle setback

soccer:549341.body: Piotrowski "needs to be assessed because of a muscle issue," coach Paolo Zanetti announced.
soccer:549341.head: In doubt for Fiorentina game

soccer:549342.body: Palma (undisclosed) "will go through a fitness test since he's not 100 percent," coach Paolo Zanetti announced.
soccer:549342.head: Late call for Fiorentina tilt

soccer:549343.body: Lukeba (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's Bundesliga clash against Freiburg but could return Wednesday against Bayer Leverkusen, according to coach Martin Demichelis . "Lukeba has a bruised knee. At the moment he can't train, which is why he won't be available for the next game. We're optimistic he could be involved against Leverkusen on Wednesday, but we're taking it day by day."
soccer:549343.head: Ruled out against Freiburg

soccer:549344.body: Guiu (hamstring) is making progress in his recovery and has started performing exercises on the pitch while continuing his rehabilitation program close to the team, according to the club .
soccer:549344.head: Progressing in rehabilitation

soccer:549345.body: Mwene (ankle) will miss Saturday's Bundesliga clash against Union Berlin due to a minor ankle injury, according to coach Urs Fischer . "He has a small problem with his ankle, but it shouldn't be anything serious."
soccer:549345.head: Ruled out with ankle issue

soccer:549346.body: Davis (thigh) "is one of the players we'll have to find a way to replace properly," coach Paolo Zanetti announced.
soccer:549346.head: Missing again

soccer:549347.body: Ramos left Thursday's match versus Olympiacos early due to a bruised tibia, but there's optimism about his availability versus Cagliari, La Gazzetta dello Sport reported.
soccer:549347.head: Banged up in UEL bout

soccer:549348.body: Saka (quadriceps) has resumed training as he continues recovering from his muscular problem, according to coach Mikel Arteta . "Yes, they're all training. Bukayo as well is training."
soccer:549348.head: Returns to team training

soccer:549350.body: Joelinton (thigh) has been ruled out for Sunday's Premier League clash against Brighton, with no clear timetable for his return, according to coach Matthias Jaissle, per Chronicle Live . "I can say, for sure, he is not an option for the weekend. [...] We take it now step by step, full trust in the medical department and hopefully he is coming back sooner [rather than] later."
soccer:549350.head: Remains out with thigh problem

soccer:549351.body: Mendes (thigh) has been ruled out for Saturday's Ligue 1 clash against Lorient due to muscular discomfort in his left thigh and is currently following an individual recovery program, according to L'Equipe .
soccer:549351.head: Sidelined with thigh discomfort

soccer:549352.body: Davies (hamstring) was back in team training ahead of Saturday's match against Hamburger, according to his club .

soccer:549354.head: Ruled out against Elversberg

soccer:549357.body: Romero (adductor) has been left out of Atletico Madrid's squad for Saturday's La Liga clash against Elche as he continues recovering from his muscular problem.
soccer:549357.head: Remains out against Elche

soccer:549371.body: Ream could miss the rest of Charlotte FC's playoff run, according to manager Dean Smith, per Top Bin 90.

soccer:549386.body: Woledzi (concussion) remains in concussion protocol ahead of Saturday's playoff match at Cincinnati and still has steps to complete before he is fully cleared, but there is a small chance he could be ready in time, according to coach BJ Callaghan, per Ben Wright .
soccer:549386.head: Faces race to clear protocol

soccer:549388.body: Cresswell will not be eligible for Sunday's match against Toulouse, as he is on loan from the club, per Les Violets .
soccer:549388.head: Ineligible against parent club

soccer:549396.body: Aramburu (hip) is still not training with the first team Friday and has only one session left on Saturday to prove his fitness for Sunday's match against Sevilla, according to Mundo Deportivo .
soccer:549396.head: Still not training with group

soccer:549398.body: Raya (shoulder) didn't take part in Friday's training session, putting his availability for Sunday's match against Manchester City in doubt, per Isaan Khan of the Daily Mail .
soccer:549398.head: Absent from Friday training

soccer:549399.body: Rey was forced off with an apparent groin injury during Friday's La Liga match against Racing Santander after feeling a twinge while sprinting
soccer:549399.head: Forced off against Racing

soccer:549401.body: Blake (groin) practiced Friday but appears unlikely to start Saturday's Game 2 against the New England Revolution, as Andrew Rick took the key reps in drills, per Jonathan Tannenwald of The Philadelphia Inquirer .
soccer:549401.head: Back at practice but may not start

soccer:549410.body: Starfelt (hamstring) has been given medical clearance and is expected to be included in Celta's squad for Saturday's game against Villarreal, according to La Voz De Galicia .

soccer:549421.body: Ramirez is not available for the second game of the playoffs series against Nashville due to a leg injury, the MLS announced Friday.

soccer:549424.body: Lassiter could miss Saturday's duel versus FC Dallas due to a lower body concern, the MLS confirmed in Portland's corrected player status report.

soccer:549425.body: Werner is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against Houston Dynamo after picking up a lower body injury.
soccer:549425.head: Status uncertain for Saturday

soccer:549428.body: Rogers (lower body) is no longer on Chicago's MLS Player Status Report .

soccer:549429.body: Tillman (pelvis) was dropped from the MLS Player Status Report ahead of Saturday's Game 2 against St. Louis.

soccer:549432.body: Ratkov (undisclosed) missed Friday's match against Racing Santander, but manager Luis Castro said that he "has had some discomfort, but I don't think it will be serious" and added that the club wants him back only "with 100 percent certainty that there is no danger."
soccer:549432.head: Discomfort not considered serious

soccer:549433.body: Idrissi scored two goals but received a red card during Thursday's 2-1 win over Guadalajara. He's listed on the FMF disciplinary report to serve a one-game ban, but Raul Gomez of Minuto Final MX reports that he was part of the traveling squad for Sunday's second leg while the team expects a response to their appeal for removing the red card.
soccer:549433.head: Sent off after massive outing

soccer:549436.body: Engel is not in the squad for Friday's clash against Vancouver due to a quad injury, according to the club.
soccer:549436.head: Absent Friday with quad issue

soccer:549437.body: Cuypers underwent tests which confirmed his injury is worse than expected following his exit in Wednesday's meeting against America, per San Cadilla El Norte .
soccer:549437.head: Set for absence after pessimistic diagnosis

soccer:549438.body: Rossi is traveling with the squad for Saturday's visit to America but could still sit out due to a back discomfort, Jorge Avila of Marca reports.

soccer:549439.body: Garcia didn't play in Thursday's 4-0 win over Leon because of a discomfort, per Gerardo Gonzalez of El Heraldo .
